evidence: Adds src/kernel/fatal_error.h and decouples node/blockstorage from validation, addressing the boundary between node and kernel code.
rationale: Breaks the circular include dependency between node/blockstorage and validation while establishing kernel/fatal_error.h for error handling. Decoupling node logic from validation serves the kernel project's core goal of removing node dependencies, but it is deferrable internal refactoring with no stated immediate consumer.
